name: Fish Internet
summary: Wollongong/South Coast NSW dialup ISP (business name registered Oct 1998; 'Join Now! Instant Activation!' accounts, hosting, domains and PC sales); later fixed-wireless broadband as Etherwave Networks / Fish Telecom; deadpooled.

events.details: NSW business name 'Fish Internet' (BN98342450) registered 20 Oct 1998; dialup ISP serving Wollongong and the NSW South Coast from 7/8-10 Victoria St, Wollongong.

refs.label: Fish Internet homepage (Wayback Jan 1999) — 'Fish Internet, Wollongong, Australia'
AuBiz: Fish Telecom Pty Ltd — business name 'Fish Internet' registered 20 Oct 1998 (BN98342450)

events.details: Business incorporated as Internet Content & Carriage Pty Ltd (ACN 092 285 713); the same ACN was renamed Fish Networks Pty Ltd (22 Oct 2001), Etherwave Networks Pty Ltd (9 May 2002) and Fish Telecom Pty Ltd (14 Sep 2005), moving into fixed-wireless broadband.

events.details: Deadpooled; last Wayback capture of fishinternet.com.au in May 2019, domain no longer resolving (checked Aug 2026).
